question: What finite disturbance does each flagship subset tolerate?

policy_points.why: P4 tests kappa_NL < kappa_RHP where kappa_RHP = 4; P_inf tests whether finite disturbances create incompatibilities where the transverse spectrum says every portfolio is safe (the planning question)

D1.name: active-load pulse
D1.direction: + (load increase), constant power, reactive load unchanged
D1.amplitude_unit: MW (system), also % of the 329 MW bus-16 load

D2.name: synchronous mechanical-power dip
D2.amplitude_unit: MW (system base); pu on the machine base = MW / 1025.2

D3.name: PV-GFL active-power-reference dip
D3.direction: - (every present converter's p_ref scaled by 1 - a); downward only, so it never exceeds available headroom (no upward PV reserve is modelled)
D3.amplitude_unit: a = fraction of the portfolio's own converter dispatch; MW = a * replaced_pg_mw(S)
D3.empty_portfolio: vacuous: no converter, the disturbance does not act; counted as tolerating every amplitude

disturbances.nesting: D_rho = {amplitude a in [0, rho]} along the declared direction; rho1 <= rho2 implies D_rho1 subset D_rho2

simulation.integrator: scipy BDF, rtol 1e-7, atol 1e-9, fixed-step central-difference Jacobian (the G2 integrator); network solved by Newton at every right-hand side (residual < 1e-10)
simulation.pulse: two segments; the solver never steps across a switch

observables.s1: max_i |omega_i - omega_COI| over machines (pu speed), omega_COI inertia-weighted

recovery_criterion.RECOVERS: every guard satisfied throughout, D(T_end) <= 0.1 * max D on [t_pulse_end, t_pulse_end + 5 s], and the fitted envelope growth of D over the last 15 s is negative
recovery_criterion.note: the post-disturbance equilibrium is the relative equilibrium x* + c w (up to rotation); no absolute frequency restoration is required (transverse definition)

failure_criterion.FAILS_DECLARED_SECURITY: all guards satisfied up to the failure time, and either (i) growth: after the 5 s window, D(t) > 2 * max D on [t_pulse_end, t_pulse_end + 5 s] AND the fitted envelope growth of D over the last 10 s is positive, or (ii) a relative rotor angle deviates by more than pi from its equilibrium value (loss of synchronism), or (iii) the RECOVERS test fails at T_end
failure_criterion.pre_registration_smoke_tests: Four single runs were made to debug the code before this file was committed (P4: BASE D1 100 MW -> RECOVERS; flagship D1 10 MW -> hit the GFL-terminal voltage guard at 27.5 s before the first-written x20 growth rule fired; 30+33+35 D3 0.5 -> OUTSIDE (GFL terminal voltage) at the pulse end; 30 D2 200 MW -> RECOVERS). The growth rule was changed from x20 to (x2 AND positive fitted growth) because x20 cannot fire inside the voltage guards for a growing oscillation; nothing else was changed after these runs. A fifth run verified the corrected rule on the same flagship case (FAILS_DECLARED_SECURITY, growth, t = 15.6 s, all guards satisfied).

model_scope_guards.exciter_field_voltage: efd within the documented IEEEX1 [VRMIN, VRMAX] of each machine (ieee39_full.xlsx), applied to the harmonized first-order field voltage
model_scope_guards.algebraic_residual: network Newton residual < 1e-6 at every accepted step, otherwise NUMERICAL_FAILURE

config.label_rule: exactly one label per run; OUTSIDE_MODEL_SCOPE and NUMERICAL_FAILURE are never counted as stable or unstable

threshold.definition: r_S^d = inf{a : label(a) != RECOVERS}, found by continuation on the grid, then bisection between the last RECOVERS and the first non-RECOVERS grid point
threshold.bisection_tolerance: max(2 MW, 2 %) for D1 and D2; 0.01 for D3
threshold.type: label of the first non-RECOVERS amplitude: FAILS (valid threshold), OUTSIDE (scope-censored: the true nonlinear threshold is not observable in this model), NUMERICAL
threshold.no_threshold: if every grid point recovers: r_S^d > range max (censored)
threshold.small_signal_unstable: a portfolio with alpha_perp > 0 has r_S^d = 0 by definition, checked by a TDS at the smallest grid amplitude

complex.K_NL: {S : every R subset S tolerates rho}; built only for rho < rho_scope(d) = min over S of the first OUTSIDE amplitude

planning.rho_star_meaning: D1: a 200 MW load block for 0.5 s (61 % of the bus-16 load); D2: a 200 MW turbine runback at SG36 for 0.5 s; D3: a 35 % dip of the portfolio's PV output for 0.5 s
planning.P1: maximize replaced_pg_mw subject to: no spectral hyperedge of H_RHP_perp contained (any-order safe)
planning.P2: the same, additionally no H_NL(rho_star) hyperedge contained, for each family separately and for all three jointly
planning.P3: minimum damped-condenser rating (G1 R_0010000, D = 2, common rating fraction at the four core buses; MVA = fraction x 4270.7) making the P4 flagship (a) transversely stable, (b) tolerant of rho_star for each family
planning.axes: MW replaced, synchronous MVA added, controller-change norm: reported separately; no weighted scalar
